title: Floxy Network
description: This server is a safe space for players to enjoy Creative, and soon more!
body:
**Floxy Network** first began as a small SMP server created just for friends. After a few YouTube videos and growing interest from the community, the project quickly expanded into something bigger.

More than 50 players joined our private SMP, and the experience was **too good not to share**. That’s why we decided to open the doors to everyone.

Today, **Floxy Network** is available for all players to join, starting with our Creative Mode gamemode. 700+ players have joined so far.

And this is only the beginning…  🚀
